proof_summary: Legendre’s formula reduces the claim prime by prime to \(\lfloor15n/q\rfloor+\lfloor10n/q\rfloor+\lfloor6n/q\rfloor+\mathbf1_{q\mid30n-1}\le\lfloor30n/q\rfloor+\lfloor n/q\rfloor\) for every prime power \(q\). Writing \(n=qs+r\) and \(t=\lfloor30r/q\rfloor<30\), the inequality follows from the finite floor relations for \(t\); when \(q\mid30n-1\), the equation \(30r=qt+1\) makes \(t\) coprime to \(30\), yielding the extra unit, and summing over prime powers proves the divisibility.
